safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّكم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (أعلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (الباء) a preposition (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم) (في نفوسكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما.. and (كم) is like the first (إن) a conditional particle that puts into the jussive (تكونوا) an imperfect defective verb (nāqiṣ), jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the noun (ism) of تكون (صالحين) khabar of تكون, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of إنّ, (كان) a past defective verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (للأوّابين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (غفورا), which is the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «ربّكم أعلم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إن تكونوا صالحين ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إنّه كان ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīl) for the implied apodosis, i.e.: if you are righteous, then He forgives you.. indeed He is ever, to those who turn back, Forgiving.
The clause «كان.. غفورا» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(الأوّابون): plural of أوّاب, an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) from آب يئوب; its pattern is فعّال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (آت) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (ذا) first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the alif (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif (حقّه) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) a conjunction in all three places (المسكين، ابن) two nouns conjoined to (ذا), accusative, (السبيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (لا) the prohibitive lā that puts into the jussive (تبذّر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "anta" (تبذيرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «آت ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تبذّر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
27- (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (المبذّرين) the noun of إنّ, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (كانوا) a past defective verb and its noun (إخوان) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (الشياطين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (كان) a past defective verb (الشيطان) the noun of كان, nominative (marfūʿ) (لربّه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفورا), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "to the favour of his Lord".. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (كفورا) the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «إنّ المبذّرين ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كانوا إخوان ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «كان الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ المبذّرين [Note: It may be resumptive.].

* Morphology:
(تبذيرا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb بذّر; its pattern is تفعيل.
(المبذّرون): plural of المبذّر, an active participle from the quadriliteral (بذّر); its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma [on the mīm] and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إمّا تعرضنّ) like إمّا يبلغنّ [Note: in verse (23) of this sūra.], (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعرضنّ), (ابتغاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb), (رحمة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (من ربّك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to [an omitted] naʿt (adjective) of رحمة [Note: or attached to (ترجوها)], and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (ترجوها) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw.. and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (قل لهم قولا ميسورا) like قل لهم قولا كريما.
The clause «تعرضنّ ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ترجوها» is in the position of a genitive, a second naʿt of رحمة [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رحمة because it is qualified.].
The clause «قل ...» is in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(ميسورا): a passive participle from the triliteral (يسر); its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:82-83.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ننزّل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is «نحن», used for majesty; (من القرآن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ننزّل) [Note: (من) here marks the starting point (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya) or is partitive (tabʿīḍiyya)... It may also be explicative (bayāniyya), in which case it is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ما). Abū Ḥayyān does not allow that, because the explicative (من) does not come before what it explains.]; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (شفاء) a khabar (predicate), nominative; (رحمة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to شفاء, nominative; (للمؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شفاء ورحمة); (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negative; (يزيد) an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is «هو»; (الظالمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (خسارا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «ننزّل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هو شفاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا يزيد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
83- (الواو) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (أعرض); (أنعمنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على الإنسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنعمنا); (أعرض) a past verb; the fāʿil is «هو»; (الواو) a conjunction; (نأى) like أعرض, the fatḥa being implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (بجانبه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نأى), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) a conjunction; (إذا) like the first; (مسّه) a past verb...
and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الشرّ) fāʿil, nominative; (كان يئوسا) like «كان مشهودا» [Note: in verse (78) of this sūra.].
The clause «أنعمنا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أعرض ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نأى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the conditional clause. [Translator's note: so in the source; نأى is coordinated with أعرض, i.e. with the apodosis.]
The clause «مسّه الشرّ» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كان يئوسا» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the second condition.

* Morphology:
(خسارا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb خسر, of the pattern-class فرح; its wazn is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ... The verb has other maṣdars: خسر with fatḥa then sukūn or fatḥa, خسر with two ḍammas or ḍamma then sukūn, خسارة with fatḥa on the khāʾ, and خسران with ḍamma on the khāʾ.
(نأى): it contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its origin is نأي — with a yāʾ at the end — because the maṣdar is النأي; the yāʾ, being vowelled after a fatḥa, was changed into an alif; its wazn is فعل.

* Rhetoric:
- Attributing good to Allah and evil to other than Him:
In the words of the Exalted: «أَنْعَمْنا عَلَى الْإِنْسانِ.. وَإِذا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ», to teach proper courtesy (adab) towards Allah the Exalted.

safi-cedvel:84-84.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (كلّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: what permitted beginning with an indefinite noun is that (كلّ) denotes generality; moreover it is understood with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «كلّ امرئ».]; (يعمل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is «هو»; (على شاكلته) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يعمل), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) a conjunction; (ربّكم) mubtadaʾ, nominative...
and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (أعلم) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, in the position of genitive, attached to (أعلم); (هو أهدى) like «هو شفاء» [Note: in verse (82) of this sūra.], the sign of the nominative in أهدى being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (سبيلا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كلّ يعمل ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يعمل» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كلّ).
The clause «ربّكم أعلم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «هو أهدى» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(شاكلة): the feminine of شاكل, a noun meaning "the like" and "the counterpart"; its wazn is فاعلة.

safi-cedvel:85-85.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يسألونك) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عن الروح) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسألونك); (قل) as before [Note: in the previous verse (84).]; (الروح) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (من أمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (ربّي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ... and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive [Note: or a conjunction, if the words after it are part of the noble Messenger's speech; this is the choice of al-Jamal.]; (ما) negative; (أوتيتم) a past verb, passive... and (تم) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (من العلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوتيتم) [Note: the preposition phrase is not attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (قليلا), because of the presence of (إلّا), since what comes after it does not govern what comes before it...]; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يسألونك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قلّ ...» [Translator's note: so printed in the source, for «قل».] has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الروح من أمر ربّي» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أوتيتم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause, in the position of accusative.].

* Morphology:
(الروح): a name for that which dwells in the body, signalling its life. Some exegetes said it is Jibrīl...

* Benefits:
- The obstinacy of the Jews and their attempts to defeat the messengers:
Al-Bukhārī, Muslim and al-Tirmidhī narrated from ʿAbd Allāh, who said: While I was with the Prophet ﷺ in a field, and he was leaning on a palm stalk, some Jews passed by him. Some of them said to others:
"Ask him about the spirit (al-rūḥ)." [Another] said: "What makes you suspicious about him?" And some of them said: "He will not confront you with anything you dislike." They said: "Ask him." So they asked him about the spirit. The Prophet ﷺ held back and gave them no reply, and I knew that he was receiving revelation, so I stood in my place. When the revelation had come down he said:
«ويسألونك عن الروح قل الروح من أمر ربي..» etc.
People have differed about the spirit that was asked about... and have taken various positions on it. The one we are comfortable with is the position of the people of interpretation:
that they asked him about the spirit by which the body has life. And the people of speculative reasoning among them said: they only asked him about the manner of the spirit and its path in the human body, how it is mingled with the body and how life is connected to it. This is something that none knows except Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Thus a human being comes to know his inability to know the reality of his own self, while knowing that it exists.
The wisdom in that is to show the intellect's inability to know a created thing that is right beside it, as an indication that it is even more incapable of knowing its Creator...

safi-cedvel:86-87.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive — or a conjunction —; (اللام) the lām that prepares for an oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (شئنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (اللام) the lām of the oath; (نذهبنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative, and (النون) is for emphasis; the fāʿil is «نحن», used for majesty; (الباء) a preposition; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb نذهبنّ; (أوحينا) like شئنا, but having no grammatical position; (إلى) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أوحينا); (ثمّ) a conjunction; (لا تجد.. وكيلا) like its counterpart [Note: in verse (75) of this sūra.], and the preposition phrase (به) is attached to the notion of "being established" (al-istiqrār) to which the preposition phrase (لك) is attached, and that is the second object.
The clause «شئنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive — or conjoined to an earlier resumptive clause —.
The clause «نذهبنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam)... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «أوحينا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «لا تجد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the oath clause.
87- (إلّا) a particle of exception; (رحمة) accusative as a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) [Note: or joined (muttaṣil), because mercy is of the same kind as a "guardian" according to the view of some exegetes... According to al-ʿUkbarī it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) after the إلّا used for rectification (istidrāk), i.e. "but We preserved it out of mercy"; he also allows it to be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being «لكن رحمناك رحمة».]; (من ربّك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رحمة) [Note: or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة.], and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (فضله) the noun of إنّ, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (على) a preposition; (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كبيرا), which is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «إنّ فضله كان ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان عليك كبيرا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:29-38.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لا) the prohibitive lā that puts into the jussive (تجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (يدك) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (مغلولة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (إلى عنقك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مغلولة)..
and (الكاف) is like the first, (الواو) a conjunction (لا تبسطها) like لا تجعل, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (كلّ) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), because it is annexed to the maṣdar (البسط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya) (تقعد) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and the fāʿil is "anta" (ملوما) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (محسورا) a second ḥāl, accusative..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقعد..) is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined to a maṣdar implied from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there not be from you a shackling of your hand or an extending, and so a sitting in blame and regret.
The clause «لا تجعل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تبسطها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تجعل.
The clause «تقعد ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
30- (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — (ربّك) the noun of إنّ, accusative..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (يبسط) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (الرزق) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (اللام) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive, attached to (يبسط), (يشاء) like يبسط, and likewise (يقدر), (إنّه كان بعباده خبيرا) like إنّه كان للأوّابين غفورا [Note: in verse (25) of this sūra.], (بصيرا) a second khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative.
The clause «إنّ ربك يبسط ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يبسط ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يقدر ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يبسط.
The clause «إنّه كان بعباده ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان بعباده ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
31- (الواو) a conjunction (لا) the prohibitive lā that puts into the jussive (تقتلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (أولادكم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi (خشية) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (إملاق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (نرزقهم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (الواو) a conjunction (إيّاكم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the third-person object pronoun (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (قتلهم) the noun of إنّ, accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (كان) a past defective verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (خطئا) the khabar of كان, accusative (كبيرا) naʿt (adjective) of (خطئا), accusative.
The clause «لا تقتلوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the request clause لا تجعل.
The clause «نحن نرزقهم ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «نرزقهم ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (نحن).
The clause «إنّ قتلهم كان ...» has no grammatical position, a second reason — or an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كان خطئا ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
32- (الواو) a conjunction (لا تقربوا الزنى) like لا تقتلوا أولادكم.. and the sign of the accusative of the object is the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif (إنّه كان فاحشة) like إنّه كان.. غفورا [Note: in verse (25) of this sūra.], (الواو) a conjunction (ساء) a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), and the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent, its implied form being "هو" (سبيلا) tamyīz (specification) of the agent pronoun, accusative, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. fornication.
The clause «لا تقربوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تقتلوا..
The clause «إنّه كان ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «كان فاحشة ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «ساء سبيلا» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the predicate clause [Note: It may be conjoined to the reason-giving clause.].

* Morphology:
(البسط): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb بسط; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ملوما): a passive participle from the triliteral hollow weak verb لام, on the pattern مفعول with the wāw of مفعول dropped after the vowel-shift (iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn); its original form is ملووم — with ḍamma on the first wāw — then the ḍamma was moved from the wāw to the lām — iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn — then the wāw was dropped because two quiescent letters met, so it became ملوم, like مقول.
(محسورا): a passive participle from the triliteral حسر; its pattern is مفعول.
(خطئا): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb خطئ يخطأ, of the فرح class.. There is also a reading خطأ with fatḥa on the khāʾ and the ṭāʾ; the pattern of خطئا is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(الزنى): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb زنى يزني, of the ضرب class; its pattern is فعل with kasra then fatḥa.. It contains a change by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb), since the yāʾ — the lām of the word — was changed to alif because it was vowelled and came after a fatḥa.
(مظلوما): a passive participle from the triliteral ظلم; its pattern is مفعول.
(منصورا): a passive participle from the triliteral نصر; its pattern is مفعول.
(مسئولا): a passive participle from the triliteral سأل; its pattern is مفعول.
(كلتم): it contains a change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf) suiting its being built on sukūn, because it is a hollow weak verb whose ʿayn is dropped when it is built on sukūn through attachment to a vowelled nominative pronoun; its pattern is فلتم.
(زنوا): it contains a change by deletion, for it is an assimilated weak verb (mithāl) whose fāʾ is dropped in the imperfect and the imperative when its ʿayn takes kasra in the imperfect; its pattern is علوا with kasra on the ʿayn.
(القسطاس): it is an Arabized Greek (Rūmī) word meaning "the balance"; it is read with kasra on the qāf — as here — and with ḍamma.
(تأويلا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أوّل in the sense of "to return", so التأويل here means "the outcome"; its pattern is تفعيل.
(تقف): the imperfect of قفا; it contains a change by deletion suiting the jussive; its pattern is تفع.
(تمش): the imperfect of مشى; it contains a change by deletion suiting the jussive; its pattern is تفع.
(مرحا): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb مرح; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(طولا): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb طال يطول; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(مكروها): a passive participle from the triliteral كره; its pattern is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلى عُنُقِكَ وَلا تَبْسُطْها كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ».
He depicted the miser as one whose hand is held back from giving and tied to his neck so that he cannot stretch it out, and He likened extravagance to the extending of the palm such that it retains nothing.
Two representations of the withholding of the stingy and the extravagance of the squanderer, to restrain them from both, and to urge them towards the moderation between them, the middle course between excess and deficiency; and that is the praiseworthy generosity, for the best of affairs are their middle ones.
2- Ordered folding and unfolding (al-laff wa-l-nashr al-murattab): «فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُوماً مَحْسُوراً».
The word «ملوما» refers back to miserliness, and the word «محسورا» to extravagance, i.e. people will blame you if you are miserly, and you will become cut off [destitute] if you are extravagant.
3- Prolixity (al-iṭnāb): in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مَظْلُوماً فَقَدْ جَعَلْنا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطاناً فَلا يُسْرِفْ فِي الْقَتْلِ إِنَّهُ كانَ مَنْصُوراً». Iṭnāb is originally taken from "aṭnaba fī al-shayʾ" when one goes to lengths in a thing; one says "aṭnabat al-rīḥ" when the wind blows hard, and "aṭnaba fī al-sayr" when one goes hard in travelling. In the terminology of the rhetoricians it is an excess of wording over the meaning for a benefit; if there is no benefit in the excess it is called taṭwīl (verbosity).
The meaning of this verse came concisely in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصاصِ حَياةٌ», but the first is iṭnāb and the second is ījāz (concision), and both are described as equivalence (musāwāt).
4- Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كانَ مَسْؤُلًا».
I.e. "asked about", with the omission of the preposition; and it is possible that there is no omission at all and the speech is by way of imaginative attribution (takhyīl), as though it is said to the covenant: why were you broken, and why were you not fulfilled — as a rebuke to the breaker, just as it is said to the girl buried alive (بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ). One may also regard it as an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya) with an imaginative one (takhyīliyya), in that the covenant is likened to one whose covenant has been broken, and the attribution of being asked to it is takhyīl.
5- Sarcasm (al-tahakkum):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَخْرِقَ الْأَرْضَ».
It is a reason for the prohibition, and it contains sarcasm towards the conceited, i.e. you will not be able to make a tear in it by your trampling and the force of your tread, and you will not reach the mountains by your self-aggrandizement and stretching up your stature — so where do you stand to be arrogant over it?

* Benefits:
1- Moderation in affairs «وَلا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلى عُنُقِكَ وَلا تَبْسُطْها كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ».
In this verse Allah struck a parable for moderation in affairs: He placed stinginess and extravagance at two opposite extremes, and called people to balance and the middle course between the two qualities. This example has its counterparts in every one of the virtues, each of which lies midway between two vices, one of them excess and the other deficiency.
Among the examples of that are cowardice and recklessness: courage lies between them. There is much like this; Allah and His Messenger described this community as a middle community, and the Messenger confirmed that with his saying: "The best of affairs is the middle", or "The best of affairs are their middle ones".
2- The fāʾ of causation and the wāw of accompaniment:
«أن» is implied after the fāʾ and the wāw under two basic conditions, namely that they be preceded by a pure negation or a pure request, whether the negation is a particle, a verb or a noun, or a diminution (taqlīl) meant as negation; diminution as in: قلما تأتينا فتحدثنا. As for request, it comprises seven things, namely: command, prohibition, supplication, offer (ʿarḍ), urging (taḥḍīḍ), interrogation and wishing (tamannī); these are seven, and with negation they become eight. Some added hoping (tarajjī), so altogether they are nine, gathered in the saying of the poet:
مر وانه وادع وسل عرض لحضّهم تمنّ وارج كذاك النفي قد كملا (Command, forbid, supplicate, ask, offer, urge them, wish and hope; likewise negation — and so it is complete.)
By their saying «pure negation or request» the grammarians excluded a negation that follows the hamza of affirmation (taqrīr), because taqrīr is affirmation; and a negation followed by a negation, because the negation of a negation is affirmation; and a negation undone by «إلّا». By that the necessary purity for implying «أن» and putting the verb in the accusative is realized. This is a summary of the matter, and in the comprehensive books of grammar there is much about these two particles.
4- [Translator's note: the source numbers this item 4; there is no item 3.] Twenty-five matters which Allah decreed....!
1- لا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلهاً آخَرَ.
2- Worshipping Him alone.
3- The prohibition of worshipping anyone other than Him.
4- بِالْوالِدَيْنِ إِحْساناً.
5- فَلا تَقُلْ لَهُما أُفٍّ.
6- وَلا تَنْهَرْهُما.
7- وَقُلْ لَهُما قَوْلًا كَرِيماً.
8- وَاخْفِضْ لَهُما جَناحَ الذُّلِّ.
9- وَقُلْ رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُما.
10- وَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبى حَقَّهُ
11- وَالْمِسْكِينَ.
12- وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ.
13- وَلا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيراً.
14- فَقُلْ لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَيْسُوراً.
15- وَلا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً.
16- وَلا تَبْسُطْها كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ.
17- وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ.
18- وَلا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنى.
19- وَلا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ.
20- فلا يسرف في القتل.
21- وَأَوْفُوا بِالْعَهْدِ.
22- وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ.
23- وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطاسِ.
24- وَلا تَقْفُ ما لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ.
25- وَلا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحاً.

safi-cedvel:88-88.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (لئن) like the previous one [Note: in verse (86) of this sūra.]; (اجتمعت) a past verb, and (التاء) marks the feminine and is vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الإنس) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الجنّ) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الإنس by the wāw, nominative; (على) a preposition; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يأتوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بمثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأتوا); (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (القرآن) a badal (substitute) of ذا — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, genitive; (لا) negative; (يأتون) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (بمثله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتون), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتوا ...) is in the position of genitive by (على), attached to (اجتمعت).
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; (بعضهم) the noun of كان, nominative... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لبعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ظهيرا), which is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إن اجتمعت الإنس ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا يأتون ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath (jawāb al-qasam)... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «كان بعضهم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

* Morphology:
(ظهيرا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral verb ظهر in the sense of "to help"; its wazn is فعيل.

* Benefits:
- The coordinating wāw combined with conditional «لو»: when the conjunction «الواو» comes before «لو», it coordinates with something implied, and the omission of what it is coordinated with is regular, because the coordinated element clearly indicates it.
So in the words of the Exalted «وَلَوْ كانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيراً», the coordination here is with something implied, i.e. "they would not produce the like of it".

safi-cedvel:89-89.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (صرّفنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صرّفنا); (في) a preposition; (هذا القرآن) like the previous one [Note: in the previous verse (88).], attached to (صرّفنا); (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the object of صرّفنا, i.e. "We have varied a lesson from every example" — or "an example from every example"; (مثل) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الفاء) a conjunction; (أبى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (أكثر) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) [Note: the preceding verb (أبى) carries a sense of negation, i.e. "they accepted nothing but disbelief".]; (كفورا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «صرّفنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to an implied oath... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أبى أكثر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the oath-response clause.

* Morphology:
(كفورا): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb كفر; its wazn is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:90-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لن) a particle of negation and of the subjunctive; (نؤمن) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the fāʿil is «نحن»; (اللام) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نؤمن); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (تفجّر) an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after حتّى; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (لنا) like لك, attached to (تفجّر); (من الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفجّر) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ينبوعا).]; (ينبوعا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفجّر..) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (نؤمن).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: it may be conjoined to the previous clause «أبى أكثر الناس».].
The clause «لن نؤمن ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تفجّر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the concealed particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
91- (أو) a conjunction; (تكون) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تفجّر); (لك) like the first, attached to the khabar (predicate) of تكون; (جنّة) the noun of تكون, nominative (marfūʿ); (من نخيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of جنّة; (عنب) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to نخيل by the wāw; (الفاء) a conjunction; (تفجّر) like تفجر, conjoined to (تكون); (الأنهار) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (خلالها) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تفجّر), and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (تفجيرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «تكون لك جنّة ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تفجر.
The clause «تفجّر» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تكون.
92- (أو تسقط السماء) like «تفجّر الأنهار»; (الكاف) a preposition [Note: or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its qualifier, i.e. "a causing-to-fall like that which you claimed".]; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. «إسقاطا كالذي زعمته»; (زعمت) a past verb and its fāʿil, and the returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted; (على) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تسقط); (كسفا) a ḥāl, accusative, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «ذات كسف» ("in pieces"); (أو تأتي) like «أو تسقط»; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأتي); (الملائكة) conjoined to the Name of Majesty by the wāw, genitive; (قبيلا) a ḥāl, accusative, from the Name of Majesty and the angels [Note: or from the angels only, if it is the plural of قبيلة... That is valid on interpreting it as a derived word, i.e. "gathered together".].
The clause «تسقط ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تكون...
The clause «زعمت ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «تأتي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تسقط.
93- (أو يكون لك بيت من زخرف) like «أو تكون لك جنّة..»; (أو ترقى) like «أو تسقط», the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (في السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ترقى); (الواو) a conjunction; (لن نؤمن.. علينا كتابا) like «لن نؤمن ... ينبوعا»; (نقرؤه) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «نحن».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنزّل..) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (نؤمن).
(قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (سبحان) mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, accusative; (ربّي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ... and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (هل) an interrogative particle used for negation; (كنت) a defective past verb and its noun; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بشرا) khabar, accusative; (رسولا) a naʿt of (بشرا), accusative [Note: it may be the khabar itself, and (بشرا) would then be a ḥāl of (رسولا).].
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «(أسبّح) سبحان» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «هل كنت إلّا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(ينبوعا): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning "a spring of water"; its wazn is يفعول, like يعقوب, from «عبّ الماء» when water swells and its waves multiply. [Translator's note: so in the source; the root of ينبوع is ن ب ع.] (تفجيرا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb فجّر; its wazn is تفعيل.
(كسفا): plural of كسفة, meaning "a piece", from «كسفت الثوب», i.e. "I cut the garment"; its wazn is فعلة with kasra on the fāʾ.
(قبيلا): either an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) meaning "face to face" (muqābil), with the wazn فعيل, or the plural of قبيلة, a non-derived noun.
(ترقى): it contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its origin is ترقي with a yāʾ at the end, which, being vowelled after a fatḥa, was changed into an alif [Note: (رقيّك): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral رقي; its wazn is فعول with two ḍammas. It contains iʿlāl by substitution: the wāw and the yāʾ met, the first being quiescent, so the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and assimilated, then the letter before the yāʾ was given kasra for harmony.].

* Benefits:
- The disputation of Quraysh:
History has preserved for us that the men of Quraysh — such as ʿUtba and Shayba, the two sons of Rabīʿa, Abū Sufyān, al-Naḍr ibn al-Ḥārith, Abū Jahl, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Umayya, Umayya ibn Khalaf, Abū al-Bakhtarī, al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra and others —, when they were unable to match the Qur'an and were not content with it as a miracle, gathered — according to what Ibn Isḥāq and others mentioned — after sunset behind the Kaʿba. Then some of them said to others: "Send for Muḥammad ﷺ, speak with him and argue with him, so that you will have discharged your excuse regarding him." So they sent to him: "The nobles of your people have gathered for you to speak with you, so come to them."
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to them, thinking that a change of mind had occurred to them concerning what he had spoken to them about — for he was eager, loved their right guidance, and their hardship weighed heavily on him — until he sat with them. They said to him:
"O Muḥammad, we have sent for you to speak with you. By Allah, we know of no man among the Arabs who has brought upon his people what you have brought upon your people: you have reviled the forefathers, found fault with the religion, reviled the gods, called our minds foolish and split the community; there is no ugly thing left but you have brought it between us and you" — or as they said to him. "If you have brought this talk only seeking wealth by it, we will collect for you from our wealth until you are the richest of us. If you seek honour among us by it, we will make you our chief. If you want kingship by it, we will make you king over us. And if this which comes to you is a raʾiyy (a spirit) you see, which has overcome you" — they used to call a follower from the jinn raʾiyy — "and perhaps that is so, we will spend our wealth in seeking medicine for you until we cure you of it, or are excused regarding you." [Translator's note: the source prints «في طلب الطلب», evidently for «في طلب الطب» ("seeking medicine"), translated accordingly.]
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them:
"I am not as you say. I have not brought what I have brought you seeking your wealth, nor honour among you, nor kingship over you. Rather, Allah has sent me to you as a messenger, sent down a Book to me, and commanded me to be a bearer of good news and a warner to you. I have conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and given you sincere counsel. If you accept from me what I have brought you, it is your portion in this world and the Hereafter; and if you reject it, I will be patient for Allah's command until Allah judges between me and you" — or as he ﷺ said. They said: "O Muḥammad, if you will not accept anything from us of what we have offered you, you know that there are no people with a narrower land, less water or a harder life than us. So ask your Lord, who sent you with what He sent you, to move away from us these mountains that have hemmed us in, to spread out our land for us, to make rivers burst forth in it for us like the rivers of Syria, and to resurrect for us those of our forefathers who have passed away — and let there be among those He resurrects for us Quṣayy ibn Kilāb, for he was a truthful elder — so that we may ask them about what you say: is it true or false? If they confirm you and you do what we have asked, we will believe you, and through it we will know your standing with Allah the Exalted, and that He has sent you as a messenger as you say." He ﷺ said to them: "I was not sent to you for this. I have only brought you from Allah the Exalted what He sent me with, and I have conveyed to you what I was sent to you with. If you accept it, it is your portion in this world and the Hereafter; and if you reject it, I will be patient for Allah's command until Allah judges between me and you." They said: "If you will not do this for us, then take for yourself: ask your Lord to send an angel with you who will confirm what you say and answer us on your behalf; and ask Him to make for you gardens, palaces and treasures of gold and silver, by which He will free you from what we see you seeking — for you stand in the markets and seek a livelihood as we seek it — so that we may know your merit and your standing with your Lord, if you are a messenger as you claim." He ﷺ said to them: "I will not do it; I am not one who asks his Lord for this, and I was not sent to you with this. Rather, Allah has sent me as a bearer of good news and a warner. If you accept from me what I have brought you, it is your portion in this world and the Hereafter; and if you reject it, I will be patient for Allah's command until Allah judges between me and you." They said: "Then cause pieces of the sky to fall upon us, as you claimed that your Lord, if He wished, would do; for we will not believe you unless you do it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "That rests with Allah, Mighty and Majestic; if He wishes to do it to you, He will do it."
They said: "O Muḥammad, did your Lord not know that we would sit with you, ask you what we have asked and demand from you what we demand, so that He might come to you beforehand and teach you how to answer us, and tell you what He will do with us in that case if we do not accept from you what you have brought us? It has reached us that you are only taught this by a man from al-Yamāma called al-Raḥmān, and by Allah we will never believe in al-Raḥmān. We have discharged our excuse to you, O Muḥammad, and by Allah we will not leave you and what you have done to us until we perish or you destroy us."
When they said that, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rose from them and went away to his family, sad and grieved, because of what had escaped him of the hope he had for his people when they called him.
So there came down of the Qur'an what came down concerning these obstinate, wrongdoing polytheists.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).. (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address (من) a preposition (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أوحى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif (إلى) a preposition.. and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أوحى), (ربّك) fāʿil (agent), nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (من الحكمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid), i.e. of what your Lord revealed to you, in the state of its being of wisdom [Note: It may be attached to (أوحى), or it is a badal (substitute) of the relative with the repetition of the preposition.], (الواو) a conjunction (لا تجعل ... ملوما مدحورا) like لا تجعل.. مذموما مخذولا [Note: in verse (22) of this sūra.], (تلقى) an imperfect verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "anta" (في جهنم) a preposition and its genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, and the preposition is attached to (تلقى).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تلقى) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding prohibition.
The clause «ذلك ممّا أوحى ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أوحى إليك ربّك ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تجعل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تلقى ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī) (الفاء) resumptive (أصفاكم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif.. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (ربّكم) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (بالبنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أصفاكم), (الواو) a conjunction [Note: or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause after it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) implied before it.], (اتّخذ) like أصفى, and the fāʿil is "huwa" (من الملائكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a second object (إناثا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) (إنّكم) a particle resembling the verb.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of إنّ (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (تقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (قولا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, with the direct object implied.], (عظيما) naʿt (adjective) of (قولا), accusative.
The clause «أصفاكم ربّكم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أصفاكم.
The clause «تقولون ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «إنكم لتقولون ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(أصفى): the alif came fourth, so it was written in the form of yāʾ, and it is changed from a wāw, the triliteral being صفا يصفو ... In the word there is a change by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb); its original form is أصفى — with a yāʾ at its end — the yāʾ was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa, so it was changed to alif; its pattern is أفعل ...
In (أصفاكم) the alif became medial, so it was written as a tall alif..

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (اللام) the lām of oath for an implied oath (قد) a particle of verification (taḥqīq) (صرّفنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (في) a preposition (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh) (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صرّفنا), (القرآن) badal (substitute) of ذا — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — genitive (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl) (يذّكّروا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (ما) negating (يزيدهم) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "huwa", i.e. the varying [of the discourse] (al-taṣrīf) (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr) (نفورا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «قد صرّفنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «يذّكّروا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن); the interpreted maṣdar (أن يذّكّروا..) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (صرّفنا).
The clause «ما يزيد ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.].

* Morphology:
(نفورا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral verb نفر; its pattern is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (لو) a conditional particle that does not put into the jussive (كان) a past defective verb (معه) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كان.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (آلهة) the noun of كان, nominative (marfūʿ) (الكاف) a preposition [Note: or a noun meaning "like", which is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a being like their saying".], (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: (ما) may be a relative noun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, with the resumptive pronoun omitted, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).] (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (إذا) with tanwīn, a particle of response with no grammatical position (اللام) linking the apodosis of لو (ابتغوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because two quiescent letters met.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (إلى ذي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ابتغوا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ (العرش) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يقولون) is in the position of a genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. if there were gods with Him, a being like their saying.. then they would have sought.
The clause «قل ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لو كان معه آلهة ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «ابتغوا ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

* Benefits:
- قُلْ لَوْ كانَ مَعَهُ آلِهَةٌ to the end of the verse.
- Logical and rational proofs — this verse and its counterparts in the Noble Qur'an debate with the polytheists a debate whose basis is sound logic, and whose warp and weft are the compound rational proofs which the scholars of logic and kalām among the Muslim philosophers took as conclusive proofs of the existence of Allah and His oneness, exalted is He. These rational proofs may not suffice for some of those who seek faith by way of human natural disposition (fiṭra) and deep feeling; these take from Allah's creation around them and within themselves a sufficient proof of the existence of the Creator, the Knowing, the Powerful, the Willing. These call the method by which they seek to know Allah «the law of invention» or the law of «creation and origination».
And for each there is a direction to which he turns, so race to good deeds..

safi-cedvel:43-44.t:
* I'rab:
(سبحانه) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb).. and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) a conjunction (تعالى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (عمّا يقولون) like كما يقولون [Note: in the preceding verse (42).], (علوّا) mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), accusative (كبيرا) naʿt (adjective) of (علوّا), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يقولون) is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by (عن), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعالى) [Note: (ما) may be a relative noun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, with the resumptive pronoun omitted, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).].
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحانه ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعالى ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: or conjoined to the meaning of the verb contained in the maṣdar, i.e. He is transcendent and exalted.].
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
44- (تسبّح) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (تسبّح), (السموات) fāʿil, nominative (السبع) naʿt of السموات, nominative (الواو) a conjunction in all four places (الأرض، من) two nouns conjoined to السموات, and the relative is in the position of a nominative (في) a preposition and (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative من (إن) negating (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition (شيء) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject) (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr) (يسبّح) like (تسبّح) (بحمده) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi, (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) (لا) negating (تفقهون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (تسبيحهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (إنّه) a particle of emphasis and accusative..
and (الهاء) is the noun of إنّ (كان) a past defective verb (حليما) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative..
and its noun is the pronoun "huwa" (غفورا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «تسبّح له السموات ...» has no grammatical position, in the status of giving the reason (taʿlīl).
The clause «إن من شيء إلّا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تسبّح له السموات.
The clause «يسبّح بحمده ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (شيء).
The clause «لا تفقهون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن من شيء..
The clause «إنّه كان حليما ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان حليما ...» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(علوّا): a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تعالى, falling short of the letters of its verb; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas.
(تسبيح): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb سبّح; its pattern is تفعيل.

* Rhetoric:
- The device of pointed choice (fann al-tankīt):
in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وَلكِنْ لا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ».
This device is: the speaker's intending to mention one thing rather than another that could take its place, because of a subtle point (nukta) in what is mentioned that gives it preference over the alternatives.
He, glory be to Him, singled out «تفقهون» rather than «تعلمون» because fiqh (understanding) contains something beyond knowledge, since it is working with the known after knowing it and deriving rulings from it; and what is intended, as the meaning of the speech requires, is understanding in recognizing the glorification of animals, plants, inanimate things and everything that falls under the word "thing".

safi-cedvel:45-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis (قرأت) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) (القرآن) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (جعلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (بينك) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to the verb جعلنا by its being made to contain the meaning of وضعنا ("We placed") [Note: If the verb is transitive to two objects, then the adverb is attached to the implied second object.].. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (الواو) a conjunction (بين) like the first and conjoined to it (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (لا) negating (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (حجابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (مستورا) naʿt (adjective) of حجاب, accusative.
The clause «قرأت القرآن ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جعلنا ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
46- (الواو) a conjunction (جعلنا) like the first (على قلوبهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جعلنا) [Note: In the preposition and its genitive noun there is the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in the reciting of the Qur'an".. and it may be attached to a ḥāl of the agent of ذكرت.] [Translator's note: this footnote is attached here in the source, but its content matches the later footnote on (في القرآن).].. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (أكنّة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle (يفقهوه) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi (الواو) a conjunction (في آذانهم وقرا) like على قلوبهم أكنّة and conjoined to it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفقهوه) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "for fear that they understand it" or "out of aversion that..".
(الواو) a conjunction (إذا ذكرت ربّك) like إذا قرأت القرآن.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (في القرآن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذكرت) [Note: In the preposition and its genitive noun there is the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in the reciting of the Qur'an", and it may be attached to a ḥāl of the agent of ذكرت.], (وحده) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of ربّك.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (ولّوا) like ابتغوا [Note: in verse (42) of this sūra.], (على أدبارهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the agent of ولّوا.. and (هم) is like the first (نفورا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being a synonym of it.], accusative.
The clause «جعلنا على قلوبهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جعلنا بينك..
The clause «يفقهوه ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «ذكرت ...» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ولّوا ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(مستورا): a passive participle from the triliteral (ستر); its pattern is مفعول..
It has the meaning of the active participle, a rational (intellectual) figure (majāz ʿaqlī).

* Benefits:
1- The word «وحده» is not pronounced except in the accusative, with the exception of anomalous (shādhdh) uses of it.
One says «يسبح وحده» ("a unique weaver") in praise, and «جحيش وحده» ("a lone little donkey") in blame. It is said of one pleased with his own opinion, who keeps to serving himself alone; and its interpretation is "alone" or "singly"..
And we say: جاء وحده ("he came alone") and مررت به وحده ("I passed by him alone"). In all of that it is parsed as a ḥāl.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject) (أعلم) khabar (predicate), nominative (الباء) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم) (يستمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يستمعون), (إذا) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), attached to أعلم [Translator's note: the source heads this word (إذا), while the verse has إذ.] (يستمعون إليك) like يستمعون به, and (الواو) a conjunction (إذ) like the first and conjoined to it (هم نجوى) like نحن أعلم, and the sign of the nominative of the khabar is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif [Note: This khabar involves the omission of a muḍāf if (نجوى) is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: they are people of secret counsel; if it is a plural of نجي, there is no implication.], (إذ) like the first, and it is a badal (substitute) of إذ هم.. (يقول) an imperfect verb, nominative (الظالمون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw (إن) a particle of negation (تتّبعون) like يستمعون (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr) (رجلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (مسحورا) naʿt (adjective) of (رجلا), accusative.
The clause «نحن أعلم ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يستمعون (the first)» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يستمعون (the second)» is in the position [Translator's note: the source omits the case here; the parallel clauses read "of a genitive"] by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «هم نجوى ...» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the second (إذ) to it.
The clause «يقول الظالمون ...» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the third (إذ) to it.
The clause «تتّبعون ...» is in the position of an accusative, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(انظر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "anta" (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a ḥāl (circumstantial), its governor being ضربوا.. (ضربوا) a past verb and its fāʿil (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ضربوا), (الأمثال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (الفاء) a conjunction (ضلّوا) like ضربوا (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause (لا) negating (يستطيعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, by the verb before it being made to contain the meaning of يعرفون ("they know") or يجدون ("they find").
The clause «انظر ...» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ضربوا ...» is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking which means "reflect"; the verb has been suspended (ʿulliqa) by the interrogative كيف, and is restricted by the preposition.
The clause «ضلّوا ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause ضربوا.
The clause «لا يستطيعون ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause ضلّوا.

safi-cedvel:94-96.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (منع) a past verb; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, accusative (manṣūb); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنوا); (جاءهم) like منع... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الهدى) the fāʿil of جاء, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (قالوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (الهمزة) for interrogation expressing astonishment; (بعث) like منع; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بشرا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (رسولا), accusative; (رسولا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنوا ...) is in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi, governed by منع.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا..) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of منع.
The clause «منع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «جاءهم الهدى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أبعث الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
95- (قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil is «أنت»; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) —; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a khabar (predicate) placed first; (ملائكة) the noun of كان, nominative; (يمشون) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (مطمنّين) a ḥāl, accusative, from the fāʿil of يمشون; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (نزّلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نزّل); (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّلنا); (ملكا) a ḥāl, accusative, from (رسولا), the mafʿūl bihi of the verb نزّلنا.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كان في الأرض ملائكة ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يمشون ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ملائكة.
The clause «نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
96- (قل) like the first; (كفى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (بالله) genitive in form by the bāʾ and nominative in position as the fāʿil of كفى; (شهيدا) tamyīz (specification), accusative [Note: or a ḥāl, accusative.]; (بيني) an adverb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to (شهيدا)... and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (بينكم) conjoined to the first adverb, parsed like it and attached to what it is attached to, the sign of the accusative being the overt fatḥa; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (كان) a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (بعباده) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خبيرا - بصيرا)... and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (خبيرا) the khabar of كان, accusative; (بصيرا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: another explanatory resumption.
The clause «كفى بالله ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «إنّه كان ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كان بعباده خبيرا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:97-98.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; (يهد) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (المهتد) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ — which has been dropped from the script for lightness —; (الواو) a conjunction; (من يضلل) like «من يهد», the sukūn being overt; the fāʿil is «هو»; (الفاء) like the first; (لن) a particle of negation and of the subjunctive; (تجد) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the fāʿil is «أنت»; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied second object; (أولياء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, denied nunation because it ends in the extended feminine alif, on the wazn أفعلاء; (من دونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أولياء, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) resumptive; (نحشرهم) an imperfect verb, nominative... and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is «نحن», used for majesty; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (نحشرهم); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (على وجوههم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in (نحشرهم), i.e. "walking"... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عميا) a second ḥāl of the pronoun, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (بكما) conjoined to (عميا), and likewise (صمّا); (مأواهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنّم) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, denied nunation for being a proper name and feminine; (كلّما) an indeclinable adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (زدناهم); (خبت) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters... and (التاء) marks the feminine; the fāʿil is «هي»; (زدناهم) a past verb and its fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (سعيرا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يهد الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هو المهتدي ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يضلل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لن تجد ...» is in the position of jussive as the second apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «نحشرهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «مأواهم جهنّم ...»: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (نحشرهم).].
The clause «خبت ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi [Note: one may make (كلّ) alone accusative as an adverb, annexed to the interpreted maṣdar formed from the adverbial maṣdar-forming (ما) and the verb, i.e. "every period of the fire's abating, We increased them"... and the adverb with what it is annexed to is a ḥāl of جهنّم.].
The clause «زدناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
98- (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the reference is to the punishment; (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (جزاؤهم) khabar, nominative [Note: or it is a badal (substitute) of the mubtadaʾ (ذا), and (بأنّهم..) is the khabar; it may also be a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (بأنّهم..), the clause being the khabar of the first.]... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الباء) a preposition of causation; (أنّهم) a particle of emphasis and of the accusative... and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ; (كفروا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كفروا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم كفروا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the maṣdar جزاؤهم... or to a ḥāl of it, the governing element being the demonstrative.
(الواو) a conjunction; (قالوا) like كفروا; (الهمزة) for interrogation expressing astonishment — or disapproval —; (إذا) an adverb of future time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (كنّا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; (عظاما) the khabar of كان, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (رفاتا) conjoined to (عظاما), accusative; (الهمزة) like the first; (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb... and (نا) a pronoun, the noun of إنّ; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (مبعوثون) the khabar of إنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (خلقا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, being its synonym, the governing element being مبعوثون, i.e. "raised with a new raising" [Note: or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "created"... See verse (49) of this sūra.]; (جديدا) a naʿt of (خلقا), accusative.
The clause «ذلك جزاؤهم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كفروا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كفروا.
The clause «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنّا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّا لمبعوثون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanation of the implied apodosis, i.e. «أإذا كنّا عظاما.. نبعث من جديد».

* Morphology:
(خبت): it contains iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is خبات; two quiescent letters met, so the weak letter was dropped; its wazn is فعت.

* Rhetoric:
- Iltifāt (shift of person):
In the words of the Exalted: «وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ».
There is a shift in it from the third person to the first person, to signal complete attention to the matter of the gathering.

safi-cedvel:99-99.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (الواو) resumptive; (لم) a particle of negation and of the jussive; (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (أنّ) a particle of emphasis and of the accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty; (خلق) a past verb; the fāʿil is «هو»; (السموات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, accusative; (قادر) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (على) a preposition; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يخلق) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (مثلهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله.. قادر) is in the position of accusative, standing in for the two objects of يروا...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخلق) is in the position of genitive by (على), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قادر).
(الواو) a conjunction; (جعل) a past verb; the fāʿil is «هو»; (اللام) a preposition, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (أجلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (ريب) the noun of لا, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (في) a preposition; (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; (الفاء) a conjunction; (أبي) [Translator's note: so printed, for أبى.] a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa; (الظالمون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (كفورا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: see verse (89) of this sūra.].
The clause «لم يروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يخلق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to a resumptive clause.
The clause «لا ريب» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (أجلا).
The clause «أبى الظالمون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعل.

safi-cedvel:100-100.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) an imperative verb; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت»; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by what follows [Note: or it is the noun of (كان) implied after لو... and the clause تملكون is the khabar of كان, in the position of accusative.]; (تملكون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (خزائن) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (رحمة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (ربّي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ... and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إذا) — with nunation — a particle of response; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (أمسكتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (خشية) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative; (الإنفاق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الإنسان) the noun of كان, nominative; (قتورا) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The implied clause «(تملكون)» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The overt clause «تملكون» has no grammatical position: explicative (tafsīriyya).
The clause «أمسكتم ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كان الإنسان قتورا» has no grammatical position: resumptive, carrying a sense of causation.

* Morphology:
(قتورا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral (قتر), of the pattern-classes نصر and ضرب; its wazn is فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
1- The grammarians hold that a condition attaches only to verbs, because the verb is characterized by occurrence (ḥudūth), and therefore the condition is made dependent on the occurrence of the event; the noun, by contrast, is fixed and devoid of the sense of occurrence.
Therefore they held that when a conditional noun or particle enters upon a noun, we need to assume an omitted verb that falls between the conditional particle and the noun immediately following it.
It has been reported that one of them said: «لو ذات سوار لطمتني» ("if a woman wearing a bracelet had slapped me"), the implied form being «لو لطمتني ذات سوار».
2- Some of the later grammarians held that «إذا», when nunated, should be treated like «إذ» when it too is nunated. Both nunations, in «إذا» and «إذ», are the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), compensating for an omitted clause whose place the nunation has taken, and which is understood from the context.
They followed this up by saying that the nunated «إذا» is not the one that puts the imperfect verb in the subjunctive, because it enters upon the past verb, just as it enters upon the noun.
Among those who held this view are Abū Ḥayyān, al-Zarkashī and others, and that is not far-fetched.

safi-cedvel:49-52.t:
* I'rab:
